name: TikTok Content Creator
description: Generate viral-ready TikTok scripts with strong hooks, scene breakdowns, captions, and hashtags.

config.system_prompt:
**TikTok Content Generation Agent **

You are an AI agent specialized in creating high-performing TikTok content optimized for virality, retention, and engagement.

Your responsibilities include:

* Generating short-form video ideas (15–60 seconds) tailored to current TikTok trends.
* Writing compelling hooks within the first 1–3 seconds to capture attention.
* Structuring content with a clear flow: hook → value/entertainment → payoff → call-to-action.
* Adapting tone and style based on the target audience (educational, storytelling, comedic, dramatic, etc.).
* Suggesting visual directions (camera angles, scenes, transitions, captions, on-screen text).
* Incorporating trending formats, sounds, and hashtags when relevant.
* Optimizing for TikTok algorithm signals: watch time, rewatchability, shareability, and comments.
* Keeping content concise, emotionally engaging, and mobile-first.

Constraints:

* Content must be platform-native (fast-paced, visually engaging, no long intros).
* Avoid generic or low-retention phrasing.
* Prioritize clarity, relatability, and strong emotional or informational impact.

Output format:

* Hook
* Script / Voiceover
* Scene breakdown
* Caption
* Hashtags

instruction: Prompt-only skill — no API key or external account needed. Edit the system prompt in the config to tune its behaviour, then assign it to an agent.

name: YouTube Search
description: Search YouTube for videos, channels, and topic research.
instruction: No API key required for the default search. Set 'depth' to control how many results are fetched (default/deep). If you hit rate limits, search less aggressively or add your own YouTube Data API key in the config later.

name: Xiaohongshu Search
description: Search Xiaohongshu (RED) posts and creators for trend and product research.
instruction: No API key required. If you run a self-hosted Xiaohongshu (RED) scraper/proxy, put its endpoint in 'base_url'; leave it blank to use the built-in default. Set 'depth' to control result volume.

name: X Search (xAI Grok)
description: Search X (Twitter) by topic or keyword using xAI Grok's live search. Requires a paid xAI API key.
instruction: Requires a PAID xAI API key. Sign in at https://console.x.ai, open API Keys, create a key, and paste it into 'api_key'. Keep 'model' as grok-4-fast (or another Grok model you have access to). Live X search is billed per request by xAI.

name: X Search (Bird GraphQL)
description: Free topic/keyword search of X (Twitter) via a local Node.js scraper. Requires Node.js and X session cookies (AUTH_TOKEN/CT0).
instruction: Free, but needs Node.js installed and your own X (Twitter) session cookies. 1) Log in to x.com in a browser. 2) Open DevTools → Application → Cookies → x.com. 3) Copy the 'auth_token' cookie value into 'auth_token' and the 'ct0' cookie value into 'ct0'. 4) Set 'bird_search_mjs' to the absolute path of your local bird_search.mjs scraper script. Cookies expire periodically — re-copy them if search stops working.

name: Truth Social Search
description: Search Truth Social posts and accounts for public commentary and trends.
instruction: Requires a Truth Social access token. Obtain it from your Truth Social account/API session (e.g. the Bearer token from an authenticated session) and paste it into 'token'. Set 'depth' to control how many results are returned.

name: TikTok Search (ScrapeCreators)
description: Search TikTok videos, creators, and hashtags via ScrapeCreators for trend research.
instruction: Requires a ScrapeCreators API key. Sign up at https://scrapecreators.com, open the dashboard, copy your API key, and paste it into 'token' (replace the placeholder). The same ScrapeCreators key works for the TikTok / X / Reddit / Instagram ScrapeCreators skills.

name: X Search (ScrapeCreators)
description: Search X (Twitter) posts and profiles via ScrapeCreators for trends and sentiment.
instruction: Requires a ScrapeCreators API key. Sign up at https://scrapecreators.com, copy your API key from the dashboard, and paste it into 'token' (replace the placeholder). One ScrapeCreators key is shared across all ScrapeCreators-based skills.

name: Reddit Search (ScrapeCreators)
description: Search Reddit posts and subreddits via ScrapeCreators for discussions and opinions.
instruction: Requires a ScrapeCreators API key. Sign up at https://scrapecreators.com, copy your API key from the dashboard, and paste it into 'token' (replace the placeholder). One ScrapeCreators key is shared across all ScrapeCreators-based skills.

name: Reddit Enrich (Thread Metrics)
description: Fetch detailed engagement metrics (scores, comments, awards) for Reddit threads.
instruction: Requires a ScrapeCreators API key in 'token' (get it at https://scrapecreators.com → dashboard). Leave 'backend' as 'auto' to let it pick the best data source, or set it explicitly if you need a specific one.

name: Polymarket Search (Gamma API)
description: Search Polymarket prediction markets via the Gamma API for live odds and event data.
instruction: No API key required — the Polymarket Gamma API is public. Just set 'depth' to control how many markets/events are returned, then assign the skill to an agent.

name: Web Search (Parallel AI)
description: Search and extract web content at scale via the Parallel AI search API.
instruction: Requires a Parallel AI API key. Sign up at https://platform.parallel.ai, create an API key, and paste it into 'api_key' (replace any placeholder/shared key with your own). Keep 'beta_header' as provided unless Parallel AI tells you to change it.

name: Web Search (OpenRouter Sonar)
description: Search the web with cited answers via OpenRouter's Perplexity Sonar model.
instruction: Requires an OpenRouter API key. Create one at https://openrouter.ai/keys (you need credits/billing set up), then paste it into 'api_key'. Keep 'model' as perplexity/sonar-pro or pick another search-capable model from https://openrouter.ai/models.

name: Instagram Reels Search (ScrapeCreators)

instruction: Requires a ScrapeCreators API key. Sign up at https://scrapecreators.com, copy your API key from the dashboard, and paste it into 'token' (replace the placeholder). One ScrapeCreators key is shared across all ScrapeCreators-based skills.

name: HTTP Client
description: Send HTTP requests (GET, POST, etc.) to call REST APIs and fetch web resources.
instruction: No API key required for the tool itself. Tune 'timeout' (seconds), 'retries', and 'user_agent' as needed. If a target API needs authentication, the agent must include the auth header/token in the request it sends.

name: Hacker News Search (Algolia)
description: Search Hacker News stories and comments via the Algolia API for tech news and discussion.
instruction: No API key required — the HN Algolia search API is free and public. Just set 'depth' to control result volume, then assign the skill to an agent.

instruction: Requires a Brave Search API key. Register at https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com, subscribe to a plan (a free tier is available), create a key, and paste it into 'api_key'. Set 'use_llm_context' to true if you want richer LLM-oriented result summaries.

name: Bluesky Search
description: Search Bluesky posts and accounts for social trends and discussions.
instruction: Requires a Bluesky account and an app password (not your main password). In the Bluesky app go to Settings → Privacy and Security → App Passwords (https://bsky.app/settings/app-passwords) and create one. Put your handle (e.g. yourname.bsky.social) in 'handle' and the generated app password in 'app_password'.

name: Google Sheets
description: Read, write, and format data in Google Sheets spreadsheets.
instruction: Needs Google authorization (OAuth). Easiest: open this skill in the editor and click 'Authenticate Google' to sign in and grant access — the token is saved to 'token_path'. For server/headless use instead, create OAuth client credentials or a service account in Google Cloud Console (with the Google Sheets API enabled) and set 'credentials_path' or 'service_account_path' to that JSON file. Enter the Google account email in 'auth_email'.

instruction: Prompt-only skill — no API key or external account needed. Edit the system prompt in the config to tune its behaviour, then assign it to an agent.

instruction: Prompt-only skill — no API key or external account needed. Edit the system prompt in the config to tune its behaviour, then assign it to an agent.

name: AI Image Generator
description: Generate images (character art, scene visuals, thumbnails) from text prompts via an OpenAI-compatible image API.
instruction: Provide an API key in 'api_key' (or set IMAGE_GEN_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY on the backend). Works with any OpenAI-compatible image endpoint — change 'endpoint' and 'model' to use Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, or a self-hosted gateway. 'size' sets the default output dimensions.

name: AI Voiceover (Text-to-Speech)
description: Convert script text into natural voiceover audio via an OpenAI-compatible TTS API; returns base64 audio (and a saved file path if configured).
instruction: Provide an API key in 'api_key' (or set TTS_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY on the backend). Pick a 'voice' and 'audio_format'. Point 'endpoint'/'model' at any OpenAI-compatible speech service. Optionally set 'output_dir' to also save audio files to disk and get back the path.

name: AI Video Generator
description: Render short-form video clips from a prompt (or animate an image) via a generic async create-then-poll video API.
instruction: Provider-agnostic. Set 'api_key' (or VIDEO_GEN_API_KEY) and 'create_endpoint' to your provider's job-creation URL. For async providers, set 'status_endpoint' with an {id} placeholder (e.g. https://api.provider.com/jobs/{id}); the tool submits the job then polls until the video URL is ready. Works with Replicate-style, Runway, Pika, Kling gateways, etc.

name: MCP Connector (stdio)
description: Connect to a local Model Context Protocol server over stdio to expose its tools to the agent.
instruction: Runs an MCP server as a local subprocess. Set 'command' (npx, uvx, python, ...) and 'args' to the server you want to launch; add 'env' (KEY=VALUE per line) for secrets. Use 'allowed_tools' to whitelist specific tool names. Great for plugging in third-party MCP servers (media generation, databases, file access) without writing code.

name: MCP Connector (HTTP)
description: Connect to a remote Model Context Protocol server over HTTP/SSE to expose its tools to the agent.
instruction: Connects to a hosted MCP server. Set 'transport' (streamable_http or sse) and 'url' to the server endpoint; add auth via 'headers' (e.g. 'Authorization=Bearer xxx' per line). Use 'allowed_tools' to whitelist. Use this to attach external/remote MCP services to an agent.

name: Art & Visual Director
description: Craft precise image-generation prompts and a visual style guide for characters, scenes, and thumbnails.

config.system_prompt: You are an art director for short-form content. From a character/topic brief, produce: 1) a reusable visual style guide (palette, lighting, framing, art style), 2) ready-to-use image-generation prompts (subject, composition, style, negative cues) for character art, key scenes, and a thumbnail/cover, 3) the recommended aspect ratio/size per use, 4) consistency notes so every image matches the same character and brand. Then call the image generation tool with those prompts and review the results for on-brand consistency.

instruction: Prompt-only skill — no API key or external account needed. Edit the system prompt in the config to tune its behaviour, then assign it to an agent.

From a video script, produce: 1) clean narration text broken into timed segments, 2) pronunciation/emphasis notes and pacing (words-per-minute) per segment, 3) the recommended voice and tone for the audience, 4) SSML or plain text ready for the text-to-speech tool. Then synthesize the voiceover with the TTS tool and verify it matches the target duration and energy. Keep narration tight and mobile-first.

Be specific and data-driven; state confidence and any missing metrics as TODOs.

name: Customer Response Composer

Provide both a concise version (chat/messaging) and a fuller email version. Keep the tone professional, honest, and reassuring.

instruction: Prompt-only skill — no API key or external account needed. Edit the system prompt in the config to tune its behaviour, then assign it to an agent.

name: Gemini Image (Imagen)
description: Generate images with Google Imagen via your Gemini API key — character art, scenes, thumbnails.
instruction: Paste your Gemini API key in 'api_key' (or set GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY on the backend). Get a key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Choose an Imagen 'model' and default 'aspect_ratio' (1:1, 9:16, 16:9, 3:4, 4:3). Returns base64 image bytes.

name: Gemini Text-to-Speech
description: Generate natural voiceover audio (WAV) from text using Gemini TTS voices.
instruction: Paste your Gemini API key in 'api_key' (or set GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY). Pick a prebuilt 'voice' (Kore, Puck, Charon, Aoede, ...). Audio is returned as base64 WAV; set 'output_dir' to also save WAV files to disk.

name: Gemini Video (Veo)
description: Render short videos from a prompt with Google Veo via your Gemini API key (async; returns a video URI).
instruction: Paste your Gemini API key in 'api_key' (or set GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY). Veo generation is async: the tool submits the job and polls until ready, then returns a 'video_uri' (downloadable with your API key). Note Veo access/quota depends on your Google account; tune 'max_wait_seconds' for longer renders.
